purpose: Deterministik epistemik holat va da'volar grafigi (DAG) boshqaruvi hamda dalillar hayot sikli orqali gallyutsinatsiyani nolga tushirish
responsibilities: Da'volarni unikal ClaimID (CLM-XXXXXX) bilan ichki DAG grafigida saqlash
Kaskadli bekor qilish (Cascade Invalidation) algoritmiga ko'ra bog'liqlik zanjirini yangilash
Dalillar hayot sikli (ACTIVE, EXPIRED, SUPERSEDED, CONTRADICTED, DEPRECATED, UNAVAILABLE) o'tishlarini boshqarish
Runtime uchun mashina o'qiy oladigan so'rov interfeysini taqdim etish

guarantees.zero_unsubstantiated_promotion: Level 3+ dalilsiz hech bir da'vo VERIFIED_FACT holatiga o'tmaydi
guarantees.cascade_invalidation_guarantee: Yuqori oqimdagi fakt bekor bo'lganda quyi da'volar avtomatik SUSPECT/INVALIDATED holatiga o'tadi
guarantees.deterministic_demotion: EXPIRED yoki CONTRADICTED dalil kelganda holat DARHOL pasaytiriladi
guarantees.isolation: Tashqi taqdimot formatlash xatolari ichki epistemik holatga ta'sir qilmaydi

failure_modes: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Dalil darajasi o'tish talabiga yetmaydi
CYCLIC_INFERENCE: Da'volar grafigida sirkulyar bog'liqlik aniqlandi
STALE_EVIDENCE_DEPENDENCY: Eskirgan dalilga tayanayotgan da'vo aniqlandi
